title: 2019 – Joint ICT Spring Dinner 2019
author: hkwtia
plainText: To welcome the New Year of The Pig, Hong Kong Wireless Technology Industry Association (WTIA) , Hong Kong Information Technology Federation (HKITF), Hong Kong Retail Technology Industry Association (RTIA) organised Joint ICT Spring Dinner. This event was also supported by some other ICT associations.
